evidence.title: Benefits of pre-operative oral Sucrosomial® iron supplementation in cardiac surgery: influence of patient's baseline hemoglobin and gender.
evidence.authors: Weltert LP; De Rosa A; Rondinelli MB; Falco M; Turani F; Pierelli L
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.dose: 13 g/d | 60 mg/d | 0.7 g/d | 0.1 g/d | 0.5 units | 1.2 units
evidence.outcome: Main end-point variables were increase in Hb from randomization to hospital admission, transfusion requirements, and cost-effectiveness of Sucrosomial® iron administration. | RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001). | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 입원 시 Hb는 철분군과 대조군에서 각각 0.7 g/dL와 0.1 g/dL 증가했으며(p<0.001), 성별에 따른 차이는 없었다. 이에 따라 수혈률(각각 30 vs 59%; p<0.001)과 수혈 지수(각각 0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt; p<0.001)가 감소했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The prevalence of low pre-operative hemoglobin (Hb) among cardiac surgery patients is high. | Patients (pt) received a one-month course of 60 mg/day Sucrosomial® iron (Iron group, n=309) or routine care (Control group, n=285) prior to elective cardiac surgery. | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.

evidence.key_finding: The results of the meta-analysis demonstrated that the probiotic group exhibited lower rates of postoperative infectious complications (OR = 0.34; 95%CI 0.25 to 0.45; p < 0.0001), hospital stay duration (SMD = -0.13; 95%CI -0.25 to -0.00; p = 0.05), lower serum endotoxin levels (SMD = -0.39%CI -0.59 to -19; p < 0.0001), and white blood cell counts (SMD = -SMD = -0.35; 95%CI -0.56 to -0.13; p = 0.002) compared to the control group.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 메타분석 결과, 프로바이오틱스군은 대조군보다 수술 후 감염성 합병증 발생률이 낮았고(OR = 0.34; 95%CI 0.25~0.45; p < 0.0001), 입원 기간이 짧았으며(SMD = -0.13; 95%CI -0.25~-0.00; p = 0.05), 혈청 내독소 수치(SMD = -0.39%CI -0.59~-19; p < 0.0001)와 백혈구 수(SMD = -SMD = -0.35; 95%CI -0.56~-0.13; p = 0.002)가 낮았다.
evidence.population: Background and Objectives: The gut-liver axis plays a crucial role in the development of post-surgical infections. | Surgery-induced dysbiosis can lead to increased bacterial translocation, impairing the liver's detoxification capacity and negatively affecting surgical outcomes. | Following liver surgery, approximately a third of the patients develop bacterial infections, with a high risk of bacteremia or even sepsis-related liver failure and death.

evidence.title: Benefits of pre-operative oral Sucrosomial® iron supplementation in cardiac surgery: influence of patient's baseline hemoglobin and gender.
evidence.authors: Weltert LP; De Rosa A; Rondinelli MB; Falco M; Turani F; Pierelli L
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.dose: 13 g/d | 60 mg/d | 0.7 g/d | 0.1 g/d | 0.5 units | 1.2 units
evidence.outcome: Main end-point variables were increase in Hb from randomization to hospital admission, transfusion requirements, and cost-effectiveness of Sucrosomial® iron administration. | RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001). | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 입원 시 Hb는 철분군과 대조군에서 각각 0.7 g/dL와 0.1 g/dL 증가했으며(p<0.001), 성별에 따른 차이는 없었다. 이에 따라 수혈률(각각 30 vs 59%; p<0.001)과 수혈 지수(각각 0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt; p<0.001)가 감소했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The prevalence of low pre-operative hemoglobin (Hb) among cardiac surgery patients is high. | Patients (pt) received a one-month course of 60 mg/day Sucrosomial® iron (Iron group, n=309) or routine care (Control group, n=285) prior to elective cardiac surgery. | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.

evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSION: In dialysis-dependent CKD, higher n-3 PUFA exposure through fish oil supplementation or higher baseline levels was associated with fewer cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Patients with dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease (CKD) have a high cardiovascular burden, prompting interest in fish oils or long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFAs) as potential risk-reducing therapies in this population. | METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies in adults receiving dialysis that assessed associations between n-3 PUFA supplementation, baseline levels, or dietary intake and CV outcomes, or all-cause mortality. | In hemodialysis-dependent CKD, fish oil supplementation lowered cardiovascular events by 44% (HR 0.56; 95% CI 0.46-0.68) and myocardial infarction by 48% (HR 0.52; 95% CI 0.34-0.78).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In dialysis-dependent CKD, higher n-3 PUFA exposure through fish oil supplementation or higher baseline levels was associated with fewer cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 투석 의존성 CKD에서 어유 보충이나 더 높은 기저 수치로 인한 더 높은 n-3 PUFA 노출은 심혈관 사건 감소 및 모든 원인 사망률 감소와 관련이 있었다.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
all_evidence.key_finding: Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 이상반응은 소폭 증가했으며(RR 1.28), 도파민성 약물에서 가장 높았다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in patients with hyperkalemia and stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease: a single-center randomized controlled trial.
evidence.authors: Wang X; Chen D; Song X; Wang J; Zhang H
evidence.venue: The Journal of international medical research
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: To observe the clinical efficacy and safety of the short-term administration of different doses of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in the treatment of hyperkalemia in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease. | Constipation was the most common adverse drug reaction, and no treatment-related serious adverse events were observed. | CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 폴리스티렌설폰산칼슘을 15 또는 30 g/day 용량으로 투여하면 3-5기 비투석 만성 신장 질환 환자에서 나트륨, 인 또는 칼슘 수치에 대한 이상 영향 없이 칼륨 수치를 빠르게 낮출 수 있다.
evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: To observe the clinical efficacy and safety of the short-term administration of different doses of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in the treatment of hyperkalemia in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease. | CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.

evidence.title: Add-on astragalus in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: A multi-center, assessor-blind, randomized controlled trial.
evidence.authors: Chan KW; Kwong ASK; Tsui PN; Chan GCW; Choi WF; Yiu WH; Cheung SCY; Wong MMY; Zhang ZJ; Tan KCB; Lao L; Lai KN; Tang SCW; READY and SCHEMATIC research group
evidence.venue: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus.
evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus. | 117 adverse events from 31 astragalus-treated patients and 41 standard care-controlled patients were documented.
evidence.key_finding: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이차 결과에는 종료 시점 혈압, 생화학 지표, 바이오마커, 병용 약물 변경 및 이상반응이 포함되었다. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) 결과: 48주 동안 eGFR 감소 기울기의 추정 차이는 연간 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2였으며(95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003), 황기 투여 시 감소 속도가 더 느렸다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Diabetes leads to chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. | Astragalus, a common herbal medicine and US pharmacopeia-registered food ingredient, is shown kidney protective by retrospective and preclinical data but with limited long-term prospective clinical evidence. | This trial aimed to assess the effectiveness of astragalus on kidney function decline in macroalbuminuric diabetic CKD patients.

evidence.title: Adynamic bone disorder in chronic kidney disease: meta-analysis and narrative review of potential biomarkers as diagnosis and therapeutic targets.
evidence.authors: Chao CT; Hou YC; Liao MT; Tsai KW; Hung KC; Shih LJ; Lu KC
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Uremic toxins are reduced by AST-120 treatment, which alleviates PTH hypo-responsiveness and bone toxicity.
evidence.outcome: Uremic toxins are reduced by AST-120 treatment, which alleviates PTH hypo-responsiveness and bone toxicity.
evidence.key_finding: Uremic toxins are reduced by AST-120 treatment, which alleviates PTH hypo-responsiveness and bone toxicity.
evidence.key_finding_ko: AST-120 치료는 요독소를 감소시키며, 그 결과 PTH 저반응성과 골 독성이 완화된다.
evidence.population: Adynamic bone disorder, common in chronic kidney disease (CKD), results from reduced bone turnover, often due to medications such as calcimimetics or high-dose vitamin D analogs that induce low parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels. | Overall, BALP and iPTH appear as potential promising biomarkers for diagnosing and monitoring adynamic bone disorder in CKD, effectively guiding therapeutic interventions.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs.
all_evidence.outcome: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Conversely, a food-drug interaction between immunosuppressive drugs and high doses of turmeric caused nephrotoxicity.
all_evidence.key_finding: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 혈액투석(HD) 환자는 산화 스트레스와 염증 위험이 증가하며, 면역억제제를 투여받는 사람은 신독성 위험도 증가한다.
all_evidence.population: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Turmeric (Curcuma longa) and its active compound, curcumin, demonstrate nephroprotective effects through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic properties. | This article evaluates the effects of turmeric and curcumin as interventions to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in HD patients and as nephroprotective agents in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy.

evidence.title: Randomized trial of two maintenance doses of vitamin D in children with chronic kidney disease.
evidence.authors: Nadeem S; Tangpricha V; Ziegler TR; Rhodes JE; Leong T; Xiang Y; Greenbaum LA
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.outcome: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.key_finding: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 환자 중 누구에게도 비타민 D 독성이나 고칼슘혈증이 발생하지 않았다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Correction of nutritional vitamin deficiency is recommended in children with chronic kidney disease (CKD). | METHODS: We conducted a phase III, double-blind, randomized trial of two doses of vitamin D3 in children ≥ 9 years of age with CKD stages 3-5 or kidney transplant recipients. | CONCLUSIONS: In children with CKD, 1000 IU of daily vitamin D3 is unlikely to achieve or maintain a plasma 25(OH)D ≥ 30 ng/mL.

evidence.authors: Shigematsu T; Koiwa F; Isaka Y; Fukagawa M; Hagita K; Watanabe YS; Honda D; Akizawa T
evidence.venue: Clinical journal of the American Society of Nephrology : CJASN

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin K1 supplementation on coronary calcifications in hemodialysis patients: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence.authors: Macias-Cervantes HE; Ocampo-Apolonio MA; Guardado-Mendoza R; Baron-Manzo M; Pereyra-Nobara TA; Hinojosa-Gutiérrez LR; Escalante-Gutiérrez SE; Castillo-Velázquez MA; Aguilar-Guerrero R
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | The severity of arterial calcifications predicts the risk of coronary heart disease and increases the risk of premature cardiovascular death.
evidence.key_finding: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 배경: 만성 신장 질환(CKD)은 관상동맥 심장 질환, 심부전 및 부정맥을 포함한 여러 심혈관계 유해 결과와 관련이 있다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

all_evidence.title: Effects of sodium bicarbonate, cholecalciferol, and protein supplementation interventions on muscle mass and metabolic disturbances in patients with chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%).
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience a decline in muscle mass and metabolic disturbances, which may increase the risk of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. | NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%). | While protein supplementation may offer some value in reducing serum phosphorus and the incidence of adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 네트워크 메타분석(NMA) 결과, 콜레칼시페롤은 근육량 증가에 유리했고(SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), 중탄산나트륨은 혈청 알부민 개선에서 더 우수했으며(SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), 단백질 보충은 혈청 인 감소(SUCRA = 64.9%)와 이상반응 발생률 감소(SUCRA = 71.9%)에서 가장 높은 순위를 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience a decline in muscle mass and metabolic disturbances, which may increase the risk of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. | Sodium bicarbonate, cholecalciferol, and protein supplementation are commonly used pharmacological and nutritional interventions; however, systematic evidence comparing their effects on muscle mass, metabolic status, and related outcomes in CKD patients remains lacking.

all_evidence.title: Maternal exposure to folate antagonists and susceptibility to congenital heart disease in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Luitel P; Yadav R; Mandal P; Adhikari N; Paudel S; Mudvari A
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control.
all_evidence.outcome: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 1976년부터 2020년 사이 발표된 6개 코호트 연구와 5개 단면 연구를 분석한 결과, 엽산 길항제에 노출된 경우 대조군과 비교해 선천성 심장질환 발생률이 유의하게 증가했다(오즈비 1.55, 95% 신뢰구간 1.28-1.87).

all_evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
all_evidence.authors: Chen C; Li Y; Wang W; Liu C; Luo Q; Ren Y; Xiong Y; Sun X; Tan J
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
all_evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
all_evidence.key_finding: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 무작위대조시험(RCT)에서 특정 생약의 산전 사용은 생아 출생률 증가(RR = 1.14, 95% CI: 1.05-1.24) 및 출생결함 위험 감소(RR = 0.46, 95% CI: 0.22-0.94)와 관련이 있었으며, 주로 보조생식술을 받은 여성에서 관찰됐다. 절박유산 또는 반복유산이 있는 여성에서는 유산 감소가 관찰됐다.
all_evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 안전성 분석에서 정맥주사용 카복시말토스철은 약물 관련 이상반응(3개 연구; 환자 471명; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02)과 오심(3개 연구; 환자 3,284명; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012)의 위험이 더 낮았다.
all_evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

all_evidence.title: The Efficacy and Safety of Myo-inositol Supplementation for the Prevention of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus in Overweight and Obese Pregnant Women: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Factor PA; Corpuz H
all_evidence.venue: Journal of the ASEAN Federation of Endocrine Societies
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included cesarean section rate, the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension, macrosomia and preterm delivery. | No adverse effects were noted. | For the secondary outcomes, standard dose myo-inositol appears to reduce the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension and preterm delivery, but the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 하루 미오이노시톨 4 g이 임신성 당뇨병, 임신성 고혈압, 조산 발생을 감소시키면서 중대한 이상반응 위험은 동반하지 않을 수 있다는 연구들이 있으나, 근거의 확실성은 낮음에서 매우 낮음 수준이다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Myo-inositol has emerged as one of the preventive therapies for the development of gestational diabetes mellitus in at-risk populations. | This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to determine the efficacy and safety of myo-inositol in decreasing the incidence of gestational diabetes in overweight and obese pregnant women. | Inclusion criteria were randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that enrolled overweight and obese pregnant women and used myo-inositol supplementation.

all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Iron deficiency during pregnancy poses a significant risk to both maternal and foetal health. | METHODS: The Cochrane Library, MEDLINE, Embase, and clinical trial registries were searched for randomized controlled trials and observational studies comparing oral iron supplementation with placebo or no supplement in non-anaemic pregnant women. | RESULTS: Twenty-three eligible studies were identified with 4492 non-anaemic pregnant women.

all_evidence.title: Prenatal exposure to medication and risk of childhood cancer - a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Lübtow A; Marron M; Nagrani R; Mulanje L; Ahrens W; Brackmann LK
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).
all_evidence.outcome: Studies with exposure to diethylstilbestrol as a known teratogen were excluded.
all_evidence.key_finding: We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).

all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The use of medication during pregnancy carries a potential health risk, including childhood cancer, for the unborn child. | METHODS: We conducted a systematic search in the databases PubMed and Web of Science for studies on medication use during pregnancy and childhood cancer risk. | We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).

all_evidence.title: Antenatal depression and adverse birth outcomes among pregnant women living with HIV in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Women who experience antenatal depression may be at increased risk of adverse birth outcomes. | Generalized estimating equations to account for twins were used to assess the relative risks of adverse birth outcomes. | We observed a 4.0 % prevalence of stillbirth and a 25.1 % prevalence of preterm birth.

evidence.title: Is antenatal or early-life vitamin D associated with eczema or food allergy in childhood? A systematic review.
evidence.authors: Zeng R; Li Y; Shen S; Qiu X; Chang CL; Koplin JJ; Perrett KP; Dharmage SC; Lodge CJ; Lowe AJ
evidence.venue: Clinical and experimental allergy : journal of the British Society for Allergy and Clinical Immunology
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: From six cohort studies, increasing cord blood vitamin D levels were associated with reduced prevalence of eczema at/close to age one (OR per 10 nmol/L increase = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I2 = 0%, 2025 participants).
evidence.outcome: DESIGN: A systematic review and meta-analyses were conducted to synthesize the published literature.
evidence.key_finding: From six cohort studies, increasing cord blood vitamin D levels were associated with reduced prevalence of eczema at/close to age one (OR per 10 nmol/L increase = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I2 = 0%, 2025 participants).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 6개 코호트 연구에서 제대혈 비타민 D 수치 증가는 1세 또는 그 무렵의 습진 유병률 감소와 관련이 있었다(10 nmol/L 증가당 OR = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I² = 0%, 참여자 2025명).
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
evidence.population: Four RCTs of vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy showed no evidence of an effect on the incidence of eczema (pooled odds ratio [OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2 = 6.7%, n = 2074). | Three RCTs reported null associations between supplementation in pregnancy/infancy and food allergy. | We found no evidence of an association between maternal antenatal or infant vitamin D level or dietary intake and the development of food allergy or eczema in offspring.

evidence.title: Maternal exposure to folate antagonists and susceptibility to congenital heart disease in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Luitel P; Yadav R; Mandal P; Adhikari N; Paudel S; Mudvari A
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control.
evidence.outcome: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 1976년부터 2020년 사이 발표된 6개 코호트 연구와 5개 단면 연구를 분석한 결과, 엽산 길항제에 노출된 경우 대조군과 비교해 선천성 심장질환 발생률이 유의하게 증가했다(오즈비 1.55, 95% 신뢰구간 1.28-1.87).
evidence.population: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.authors: Chen C; Li Y; Wang W; Liu C; Luo Q; Ren Y; Xiong Y; Sun X; Tan J
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 무작위대조시험(RCT)에서 특정 생약의 산전 사용은 생아 출생률 증가(RR = 1.14, 95% CI: 1.05-1.24) 및 출생결함 위험 감소(RR = 0.46, 95% CI: 0.22-0.94)와 관련이 있었으며, 주로 보조생식술을 받은 여성에서 관찰됐다. 절박유산 또는 반복유산이 있는 여성에서는 유산 감소가 관찰됐다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.key_finding: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Ali MS; Elfiki M; Elfeky A; Ibrahim A; Zayed M; Sobhy A; Ashour M; Hendawy AA; Elshazly A; El-Nemr AF; Elshahat A

evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.key_finding: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.

evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.authors: Chen C; Li Y; Wang W; Liu C; Luo Q; Ren Y; Xiong Y; Sun X; Tan J
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 무작위대조시험(RCT)에서 특정 생약의 산전 사용은 생아 출생률 증가(RR = 1.14, 95% CI: 1.05-1.24) 및 출생결함 위험 감소(RR = 0.46, 95% CI: 0.22-0.94)와 관련이 있었으며, 주로 보조생식술을 받은 여성에서 관찰됐다. 절박유산 또는 반복유산이 있는 여성에서는 유산 감소가 관찰됐다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Ali MS; Elfiki M; Elfeky A; Ibrahim A; Zayed M; Sobhy A; Ashour M; Hendawy AA; Elshazly A; El-Nemr AF; Elshahat A
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.key_finding: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 안전성 분석에서 정맥주사용 카복시말토스철은 약물 관련 이상반응(3개 연구; 환자 471명; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02)과 오심(3개 연구; 환자 3,284명; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012)의 위험이 더 낮았다.
evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

all_evidence.authors: Factor PA; Corpuz H
all_evidence.venue: Journal of the ASEAN Federation of Endocrine Societies
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included cesarean section rate, the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension, macrosomia and preterm delivery. | No adverse effects were noted. | For the secondary outcomes, standard dose myo-inositol appears to reduce the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension and preterm delivery, but the certainty of evidence is low to very low.

all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Iron deficiency during pregnancy poses a significant risk to both maternal and foetal health. | METHODS: The Cochrane Library, MEDLINE, Embase, and clinical trial registries were searched for randomized controlled trials and observational studies comparing oral iron supplementation with placebo or no supplement in non-anaemic pregnant women. | RESULTS: Twenty-three eligible studies were identified with 4492 non-anaemic pregnant women.

all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Women who experience antenatal depression may be at increased risk of adverse birth outcomes. | Generalized estimating equations to account for twins were used to assess the relative risks of adverse birth outcomes. | We observed a 4.0 % prevalence of stillbirth and a 25.1 % prevalence of preterm birth.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Our findings illustrate the high risk of both depression and adverse birth outcomes among WHIV and underscore the need for interventions to improve their mental health and the health of their infants; however, the relationship between depression and birth outcomes remains unclear.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.authors: Gómez-Cabrera AS; González-Santiago AE; Castañeda-Arellano R; Corona-Meraz FI; Baptista-Rosas RC; Sánchez-Parada MG
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 연구 결과는 혼재했으나, 여러 전향적 연구에서는 높은 일일 엽산(FA) 섭취량(≥800 μg) 또는 장기간 사용(>3-6개월)이 임신성 당뇨병(GDM)의 오즈 증가와 관련될 수 있으며, 특히 임신 전에 시작했을 때 그러할 수 있음을 시사했다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Is antenatal or early-life vitamin D associated with eczema or food allergy in childhood? A systematic review.
evidence.authors: Zeng R; Li Y; Shen S; Qiu X; Chang CL; Koplin JJ; Perrett KP; Dharmage SC; Lodge CJ; Lowe AJ
evidence.venue: Clinical and experimental allergy : journal of the British Society for Allergy and Clinical Immunology
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: From six cohort studies, increasing cord blood vitamin D levels were associated with reduced prevalence of eczema at/close to age one (OR per 10 nmol/L increase = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I2 = 0%, 2025 participants).
evidence.outcome: DESIGN: A systematic review and meta-analyses were conducted to synthesize the published literature.
evidence.key_finding: From six cohort studies, increasing cord blood vitamin D levels were associated with reduced prevalence of eczema at/close to age one (OR per 10 nmol/L increase = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I2 = 0%, 2025 participants).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 6개 코호트 연구에서 제대혈 비타민 D 수치 증가는 1세 또는 그 무렵의 습진 유병률 감소와 관련이 있었다(10 nmol/L 증가당 OR = 0.89; 0.84-0.94, I² = 0%, 참여자 2025명).
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
evidence.population: Four RCTs of vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy showed no evidence of an effect on the incidence of eczema (pooled odds ratio [OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2 = 6.7%, n = 2074). | Three RCTs reported null associations between supplementation in pregnancy/infancy and food allergy. | We found no evidence of an association between maternal antenatal or infant vitamin D level or dietary intake and the development of food allergy or eczema in offspring.

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.authors: Chen C; Li Y; Wang W; Liu C; Luo Q; Ren Y; Xiong Y; Sun X; Tan J
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 무작위대조시험(RCT)에서 특정 생약의 산전 사용은 생아 출생률 증가(RR = 1.14, 95% CI: 1.05-1.24) 및 출생결함 위험 감소(RR = 0.46, 95% CI: 0.22-0.94)와 관련이 있었으며, 주로 보조생식술을 받은 여성에서 관찰됐다. 절박유산 또는 반복유산이 있는 여성에서는 유산 감소가 관찰됐다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

all_evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
all_evidence.authors: Gómez-Cabrera AS; González-Santiago AE; Castañeda-Arellano R; Corona-Meraz FI; Baptista-Rosas RC; Sánchez-Parada MG
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
all_evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 연구 결과는 혼재했으나, 여러 전향적 연구에서는 높은 일일 엽산(FA) 섭취량(≥800 μg) 또는 장기간 사용(>3-6개월)이 임신성 당뇨병(GDM)의 오즈 증가와 관련될 수 있으며, 특히 임신 전에 시작했을 때 그러할 수 있음을 시사했다.
all_evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Ali MS; Elfiki M; Elfeky A; Ibrahim A; Zayed M; Sobhy A; Ashour M; Hendawy AA; Elshazly A; El-Nemr AF; Elshahat A
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 안전성 분석에서 정맥주사용 카복시말토스철은 약물 관련 이상반응(3개 연구; 환자 471명; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02)과 오심(3개 연구; 환자 3,284명; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012)의 위험이 더 낮았다.
all_evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

all_evidence.title: The Efficacy and Safety of Myo-inositol Supplementation for the Prevention of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus in Overweight and Obese Pregnant Women: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Factor PA; Corpuz H
all_evidence.venue: Journal of the ASEAN Federation of Endocrine Societies
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included cesarean section rate, the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension, macrosomia and preterm delivery. | No adverse effects were noted. | For the secondary outcomes, standard dose myo-inositol appears to reduce the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension and preterm delivery, but the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 하루 미오이노시톨 4 g이 임신성 당뇨병, 임신성 고혈압, 조산 발생을 감소시키면서 중대한 이상반응 위험은 동반하지 않을 수 있다는 연구들이 있으나, 근거의 확실성은 낮음에서 매우 낮음 수준이다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Myo-inositol has emerged as one of the preventive therapies for the development of gestational diabetes mellitus in at-risk populations. | This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to determine the efficacy and safety of myo-inositol in decreasing the incidence of gestational diabetes in overweight and obese pregnant women. | Inclusion criteria were randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that enrolled overweight and obese pregnant women and used myo-inositol supplementation.

all_evidence.title: The benefits and harms of oral iron supplementation in non-anaemic pregnant women: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Watt A; Eaton H; Eastwick-Jones K; Thomas ET; Plüddemann A
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Supplemented groups had higher haemoglobin [mean difference = 6.95 g/l, 95% confidence interval (CI): 4.81-9.09, P < .001, moderate certainty, I2 = 91%] and ferritin (mean difference = 12.22 ng/ml, 95% CI: 6.92-17.52, P < .001, moderate certainty, I2 = 87%) and were at lower risk of anaemia (relative risk = 0.50, 95% CI: 0.34-0.74, P < .001, high certainty, I2 = 42%, number needed to treat (NNT) = 10).
all_evidence.outcome: There was no difference in birth weight, preterm birth, and rate of caesarean section.
all_evidence.key_finding: Supplemented groups had higher haemoglobin [mean difference = 6.95 g/l, 95% confidence interval (CI): 4.81-9.09, P < .001, moderate certainty, I2 = 91%] and ferritin (mean difference = 12.22 ng/ml, 95% CI: 6.92-17.52, P < .001, moderate certainty, I2 = 87%) and were at lower risk of anaemia (relative risk = 0.50, 95% CI: 0.34-0.74, P < .001, high certainty, I2 = 42%, number needed to treat (NNT) = 10).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 보충군은 헤모글로빈이 더 높았고[평균차 = 6.95 g/l, 95% 신뢰구간(CI): 4.81-9.09, P < .001, 중등도 확실성, I² = 91%], 페리틴도 더 높았으며(평균차 = 12.22 ng/ml, 95% CI: 6.92-17.52, P < .001, 중등도 확실성, I² = 87%), 빈혈 위험은 더 낮았다(상대위험 = 0.50, 95% CI: 0.34-0.74, P < .001, 높은 확실성, I² = 42%, 치료필요수(NNT) = 10).
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Iron deficiency during pregnancy poses a significant risk to both maternal and foetal health. | METHODS: The Cochrane Library, MEDLINE, Embase, and clinical trial registries were searched for randomized controlled trials and observational studies comparing oral iron supplementation with placebo or no supplement in non-anaemic pregnant women. | RESULTS: Twenty-three eligible studies were identified with 4492 non-anaemic pregnant women.

all_evidence.title: Prenatal exposure to medication and risk of childhood cancer - a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Lübtow A; Marron M; Nagrani R; Mulanje L; Ahrens W; Brackmann LK
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).
all_evidence.outcome: Studies with exposure to diethylstilbestrol as a known teratogen were excluded.
all_evidence.key_finding: We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 어떤 종류의 항생제든 산전 노출된 경우 급성 림프모구성 백혈병(ALL) 위험이 증가한 것으로 나타났다[추정치(ES) = 1.14(95% CI 1.03; 1.25), I² = 19.1%, P = 0.26].
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The use of medication during pregnancy carries a potential health risk, including childhood cancer, for the unborn child. | METHODS: We conducted a systematic search in the databases PubMed and Web of Science for studies on medication use during pregnancy and childhood cancer risk. | We found an increased risk for prenatal exposure to any kind of antibiotics and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL; estimate (ES) = 1.14 (95%CI 1.03; 1.25), I2 = 19.1%, P = 0.26).

all_evidence.title: Antenatal depression and adverse birth outcomes among pregnant women living with HIV in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSIONS: Our findings illustrate the high risk of both depression and adverse birth outcomes among WHIV and underscore the need for interventions to improve their mental health and the health of their infants; however, the relationship between depression and birth outcomes remains unclear.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Women who experience antenatal depression may be at increased risk of adverse birth outcomes. | Generalized estimating equations to account for twins were used to assess the relative risks of adverse birth outcomes. | We observed a 4.0 % prevalence of stillbirth and a 25.1 % prevalence of preterm birth.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Our findings illustrate the high risk of both depression and adverse birth outcomes among WHIV and underscore the need for interventions to improve their mental health and the health of their infants; however, the relationship between depression and birth outcomes remains unclear.

all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Women who experience antenatal depression may be at increased risk of adverse birth outcomes. | METHODS: We conducted a prospective cohort study of 2298 pregnant WHIV on antiretroviral therapy (ART) in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, who were participants in a randomized trial of vitamin D3 supplementation. | Depressive symptoms were assessed at 12-27 weeks gestation using the Hopkins Symptoms Checklist (HSCL-25).

evidence.title: [A phase Ⅲ clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety profile of antaitasvir phosphate combined with yiqibuvir in the treatment of adults with chronic hepatitis C].
evidence.authors: Wei L; Shang J; An X; Zhang GQ; Guan YJ; Piao HX; Jin JL; Bai L; Yang XX; Yang DK; Luo XH; Yuan SF; Zhao YR; Ma YJ; Li GM; Lin F; Wu XP; Geng JW; Zou GZ; Chang JB; Gong ZJ; Mao XR; Zhu J; Guo WT; He QW; Luo L; Zhuang YL; Xie HM; Zhang YJ
evidence.venue: Zhonghua gan zang bing za zhi = Zhonghua ganzangbing zazhi = Chinese journal of hepatology
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: The results of virology resistance analysis suggested that most virological failures in this study was associated with newly introduced mutation sites or increased mutation proportions, with baseline amino acid mutations had no overall impact on the SVR12 treatment outcomes.
evidence.outcome: The safety profile of the drug was evaluated by the incidence and severity degree of adverse events. | The results of virology resistance analysis suggested that most virological failures in this study was associated with newly introduced mutation sites or increased mutation proportions, with baseline amino acid mutations had no overall impact on the SVR12 treatment outcomes. | The adverse events (TEAEs) related to the experimental drug during this study were mostly grade 1 or grade 2, primarily including hyperuricemia, hypercholesterolemia, and hypertriglyceridemia, with overall good safety and well-tolerability.
evidence.key_finding: The results of virology resistance analysis suggested that most virological failures in this study was associated with newly introduced mutation sites or increased mutation proportions, with baseline amino acid mutations had no overall impact on the SVR12 treatment outcomes.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 바이러스학적 내성 분석 결과, 이 연구에서 발생한 바이러스학적 실패의 대부분은 새로 나타난 돌연변이 부위 또는 돌연변이 비율 증가와 관련이 있었으며, 기저 시점 아미노산 돌연변이는 SVR12 치료 결과에 전반적인 영향을 미치지 않은 것으로 나타났다.
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Multicenter Study|English Abstract
evidence.population: Objective: To assess the efficacy and safety profile of antaitasvir phosphate combined with yiqibuvir in the treatment of chronic hepatitis C (CHC) of various genotypes, without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis. | The SVR12 rate for subjects with compensated cirrhosis was 90.9% (30/33) and those without cirrhosis was 94.5% (240/254). | The rate for subjects with compensated cirrhosis was 92.3% (12/13), and those without cirrhosis was 96.4% (80/83).

evidence.title: Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and nonalcoholic fatty liver disease in adults: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
evidence.authors: Kim SJ; Cho SH; Yun JM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_3: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and adverse events (AEs) of ω-3 PUFA in adults with NAFLD.
evidence.outcome: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and adverse events (AEs) of ω-3 PUFA in adults with NAFLD. | Subgroup analyses of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine transaminase (ALT) levels were performed based on treatment duration, dosage, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), age, sex, and funding source.
evidence.key_finding: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and adverse events (AEs) of ω-3 PUFA in adults with NAFLD.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 연구는 NAFLD 성인에서 ω-3 PUFA의 효능과 이상반응(AEs)을 평가하는 것을 목표로 했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is the leading cause of liver disease worldwide. | Subgroup analyses of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine transaminase (ALT) levels were performed based on treatment duration, dosage, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), age, sex, and funding source. | The overall risk of bias was 5/20 low risk (25 %), 4/20 high risk (20 %) and 11/20 some concerns (55 %). ω-3 PUFA supplementation significantly improved gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT) (WMD = -5.38 IU/L, 95 % CI: -9.16 to -1.61) and hepatic steatosis assessed by ultrasonography (US) (OR = 3.83, 95 % CI: 1.03 to 14.27) compared with the control group, although publication bias was observed.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality.
evidence.outcome: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality. | We present a case of severe liver injury following the administration of Saibokuto and attempted to identify the likely causative crude drug inducing liver injury through a systematic literature review. | A 29-year-old woman developed severe liver injury approximately two months after Saibokuto administration, necessitating steroid pulse therapy for recovery.
evidence.key_finding: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 여러 전통 생약 제품으로 구성된 Kampo medicine은 이상반응의 인과성을 식별하기 어렵게 한다.
evidence.population: We present a case of severe liver injury following the administration of Saibokuto and attempted to identify the likely causative crude drug inducing liver injury through a systematic literature review. | A 29-year-old woman developed severe liver injury approximately two months after Saibokuto administration, necessitating steroid pulse therapy for recovery. | The search focused on studies involving human subjects, published in either English or Japanese, and specifically investigated Kampo medicines categorized as over-the-counter or prescription drugs suspected as causative agents of drug-induced liver injury (DILI).

all_evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_25: SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: The evidence suggests that silymarin monotherapy versus no intervention or placebo may result in little to no difference in serious adverse events (Peto OR 1.55, 95% CI 0.26 to 9.28; 4 trials, 304 participants; low-certainty evidence).
all_evidence.outcome: OUTCOMES: Critical outcomes were the proportion of people with serious adverse events, all-cause mortality, and quality of life. | Some of the most important outcomes were liver enzymes (i.e. alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and gamma glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT)), and the proportion of people with adverse events considered non-serious. | SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: The evidence suggests that silymarin monotherapy versus no intervention or placebo may result in little to no difference in serious adverse events (Peto OR 1.55, 95% CI 0.26 to 9.28; 4 trials, 304 participants; low-certainty evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding: SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: The evidence suggests that silymarin monotherapy versus no intervention or placebo may result in little to no difference in serious adverse events (Peto OR 1.55, 95% CI 0.26 to 9.28; 4 trials, 304 participants; low-certainty evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과 통합: 근거에 따르면 silymarin 단독요법은 무중재 또는 위약과 비교할 때 중대한 이상반응에 거의 또는 전혀 차이가 없을 수 있다(Peto OR 1.55, 95% CI 0.26~9.28; 4개 시험, 304명; 확실성이 낮은 근거).
all_evidence.population: RATIONALE: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a major public health challenge, with approximately 32.4% of adults globally diagnosed with the condition and a steadily increasing prevalence. | Some of the most important outcomes were liver enzymes (i.e. alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and gamma glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT)), and the proportion of people with adverse events considered non-serious. | INCLUDED STUDIES: We included 17 RCTs with 2069 participants having MASLD (78 participants were diagnosed with MASLD, 423 with metabolic-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), and the diagnosis of 1568 participants was not classified).

evidence.title: Kampo medicine inducing drug-induced liver injury: A case report and systematic review.
evidence.authors: Hoshi A; Funakoshi H; Otoyama Y; Yoshida H; Momo K
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality.
evidence.outcome: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality. | We present a case of severe liver injury following the administration of Saibokuto and attempted to identify the likely causative crude drug inducing liver injury through a systematic literature review. | A 29-year-old woman developed severe liver injury approximately two months after Saibokuto administration, necessitating steroid pulse therapy for recovery.
evidence.key_finding: Kampo medicine, comprising various conventional crude drug products, poses challenges in identifying adverse event causality.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 여러 전통 생약 제품으로 구성된 Kampo medicine은 이상반응의 인과성을 식별하기 어렵게 한다.
evidence.population: We present a case of severe liver injury following the administration of Saibokuto and attempted to identify the likely causative crude drug inducing liver injury through a systematic literature review. | A 29-year-old woman developed severe liver injury approximately two months after Saibokuto administration, necessitating steroid pulse therapy for recovery. | The search focused on studies involving human subjects, published in either English or Japanese, and specifically investigated Kampo medicines categorized as over-the-counter or prescription drugs suspected as causative agents of drug-induced liver injury (DILI).

all_evidence.key_finding: SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: The evidence suggests that silymarin monotherapy versus no intervention or placebo may result in little to no difference in serious adverse events (Peto OR 1.55, 95% CI 0.26 to 9.28; 4 trials, 304 participants; low-certainty evidence).

all_evidence.outcome: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84). | CONCLUSION: The combination of YGJ or its modified versions with modern medical therapies significantly enhances treatment effectiveness, Karnofsky performance status scores, and TCM syndrome scores, reduces AFP levels, and decreases gastrointestinal adverse reactions compared to modern medical therapies alone.

evidence.title: Use of tramadol and the risk of bleeding complications in patients on oral anticoagulants: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lévy C; Gosselin L; Vilcu AM; Steichen O
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Risk of bias was assessed using an adaptation of the Drug Interaction Probability Scale for case reports and case series and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for comparative studies.
evidence.key_finding: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.key_finding_ko: 4건의 비교 연구에서는 트라마돌과 비타민 K 길항제를 함께 복용할 때 출혈 위험이 증가했다고 보고했으며, 이 결과는 1건의 연구에서 통계적으로 유의했다. 중증 출혈의 통합 위험비는 2.68[95% CI: 1.45~4.96; p < 0.001]이었다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Most of the studies described tramadol-vitamin K antagonists' concomitant use; one case-control study also assessed dabigatran and rivaroxaban; one case report involved dabigatran.
