all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a common but severe complication following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. | Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis.
all_evidence.key_finding: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 향후 연구에서는 LMWH-NOAC 순차 요법을 검증하고, 위험도 층화 프로토콜을 최적화하며, 회복 향상 경로 내 상호작용 문제를 다루기 위해 대규모 무작위 대조시험(RCT)을 우선해야 한다.
all_evidence.population: Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis. | The PROLAPS II trial demonstrated rivaroxaban's efficacy in reducing VTE after laparoscopic CRC surgery, with comparable major bleeding rates to placebo.

all_evidence.outcome: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications. | This systematic review aimed to assess patient satisfaction with anticoagulation therapy for VTE and to highlight potential differences according to the type of anticoagulant. | The review focused on factors influencing the patient experience, such as perceived efficacy, ease of use, adverse effects, and health-related quality of life.
all_evidence.key_finding: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications.

evidence.title: Use of tramadol and the risk of bleeding complications in patients on oral anticoagulants: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lévy C; Gosselin L; Vilcu AM; Steichen O
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Risk of bias was assessed using an adaptation of the Drug Interaction Probability Scale for case reports and case series and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for comparative studies.
evidence.key_finding: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.key_finding_ko: 4건의 비교 연구에서는 트라마돌과 비타민 K 길항제를 함께 복용할 때 출혈 위험이 증가했다고 보고했으며, 이 결과는 1건의 연구에서 통계적으로 유의했다. 중증 출혈의 통합 위험비는 2.68[95% CI: 1.45~4.96; p < 0.001]이었다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Most of the studies described tramadol-vitamin K antagonists' concomitant use; one case-control study also assessed dabigatran and rivaroxaban; one case report involved dabigatran.

evidence.title: Rate of abnormal uterine bleeding in women on anticoagulation for venous thromboembolism: systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Taree NA; Lee A; Sivak A; Rich R; Zhu N; Wei Linda Sun H; Wu C
evidence.venue: Journal of thrombosis and haemostasis : JTH
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.outcome: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | Primary outcomes were major bleeding (MB), clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding (CRNMB) from uterine sites, and unspecified AUB; secondary outcomes were iron deficiency anemia and recurrent VTE. | AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.key_finding: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 비정상 자궁 출혈(AUB)의 정의는 다양했다: 주요 출혈(MB)(n = 12), 임상적으로 관련 있는 비주요 자궁 출혈(CRNMB)(n = 10), 그림형 출혈 평가표(n = 2), 정의되지 않은 AUB(n = 7).
evidence.population: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | We aimed to compare the incidence and risk of AUB in women receiving DOACs vs low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH)/vitamin K antagonists (VKAs) for VTE and quantify anemia and iron deficiency risks. | Rivaroxaban showed a 2.7-fold higher AUB risk than LMWH/VKA (P < .01).

evidence.title: SAMe-TT2R2 Score to Predict Time in Therapeutic Range of Vitamin K Antagonists in Asian and Non-Asian patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Poonchuay N; Saokaew S; Incomenoy S
evidence.venue: American journal of cardiovascular drugs : drugs, devices, and other interventions
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: BACKGROUND: Sex, age, medical history, treatment, tobacco use, and race (SAMe-TT2R2) score helps detect patients at risk of suboptimal anticoagulation control.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Sex, age, medical history, treatment, tobacco use, and race (SAMe-TT2R2) score helps detect patients at risk of suboptimal anticoagulation control. | OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the SAMe-TT2R2 score's ability to predict poor anticoagulation control [defined as time in therapeutic range (TTR) < 60-70%] in Asian and non-Asian populations on vitamin K antagonists (VKAs). | Further research is needed to enhance the risk assessment for poor anticoagulation control with VKAs.
evidence.key_finding: BACKGROUND: Sex, age, medical history, treatment, tobacco use, and race (SAMe-TT2R2) score helps detect patients at risk of suboptimal anticoagulation control.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 배경: 성별, 연령, 병력, 치료, 흡연, 인종(SAMe-TT2R2) 점수는 항응고 조절이 최적 수준에 미치지 못할 위험이 있는 환자를 찾아내는 데 도움이 된다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Sex, age, medical history, treatment, tobacco use, and race (SAMe-TT2R2) score helps detect patients at risk of suboptimal anticoagulation control. | OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the SAMe-TT2R2 score's ability to predict poor anticoagulation control [defined as time in therapeutic range (TTR) < 60-70%] in Asian and non-Asian populations on vitamin K antagonists (VKAs). | Further research is needed to enhance the risk assessment for poor anticoagulation control with VKAs.

all_evidence.title: Advances and Challenges in the Application of Novel Oral Anticoagulants for Venous Thromboembolism Prevention Following Colorectal Cancer Surgery.
all_evidence.authors: Kun Y; Song Z
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a common but severe complication following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. | Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis.
all_evidence.key_finding: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 향후 연구에서는 LMWH-NOAC 순차 요법을 검증하고, 위험도 층화 프로토콜을 최적화하며, 회복 향상 경로 내 상호작용 문제를 다루기 위해 대규모 무작위 대조시험(RCT)을 우선해야 한다.
all_evidence.population: Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis. | The PROLAPS II trial demonstrated rivaroxaban's efficacy in reducing VTE after laparoscopic CRC surgery, with comparable major bleeding rates to placebo.

all_evidence.authors: Talasaz AH; McGonagle B; HajiQasemi M; Ghelichkhan ZA; Sadeghipour P; Rashedi S; Cuker A; Lech T; Goldhaber SZ; Jennings DL; Piazza G; Bikdeli B
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_2: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions with food or herbs can lead to anticoagulation potentiation, increased risk of bleeding, or reduced drug efficacy, all compromising patient safety.
all_evidence.outcome: Interactions between food and oral anticoagulants (OACs), particularly vitamin K antagonists such as warfarin, are widely recognized and may also be clinically relevant for direct OACs. | Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions with food or herbs can lead to anticoagulation potentiation, increased risk of bleeding, or reduced drug efficacy, all compromising patient safety. | We conducted a systematic search for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on PubMed for assessments of interactions between OACs and various ingestants.
all_evidence.key_finding: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions with food or herbs can lead to anticoagulation potentiation, increased risk of bleeding, or reduced drug efficacy, all compromising patient safety.

all_evidence.outcome: Purpose: This study examines the correlation between time-in-therapeutic range (TTR) and anticoagulation-related adverse events (AEs) in patients with atrial fibrillation (Afib) in a pharmacist-managed ambulatory care clinic. | Methods: A single-center, retrospective cohort study was conducted at a community hospital-based outpatient anticoagulation clinic to investigate the predictive value of suboptimal TTR percentages for hemorrhagic or thromboembolic events in Afib patients. | Eligible participants were aged 18 years or older, diagnosed with Afib, and receiving warfarin therapy as current or past enrollees in the anticoagulation management program.

all_evidence.title: Prescriptions of CYP3A4- and P-gp inducers for patients on direct oral anticoagulants: Bridging the gap between epidemiology and patient management for optimal thromboembolic event prevention.
all_evidence.authors: Wuyts SCM; Moor J; Jochmans K; Cortoos PJ; Vandervorst F; Steurbaut S; Dupont AG; Cornu P
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: The nested case-control studies (n = 2) and cohort studies (n = 9) found that co-administration of DOACs and CYP3A4/P-gp inducers, particularly carbamazepine and phenytoin, increased the risk of thromboembolic events.
all_evidence.outcome: Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) are frequently used for the treatment and prevention of ischaemic stroke in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation. | Compared to vitamin K antagonists, DOACs have significant advantages, although their drug-drug interaction (DDI) profile may complicate drug efficacy and safety. | Case reports (n = 6) indicated that antiepileptic drugs such as carbamazepine, phenobarbital and phenytoin may be associated with thromboembolic events.
all_evidence.key_finding: The nested case-control studies (n = 2) and cohort studies (n = 9) found that co-administration of DOACs and CYP3A4/P-gp inducers, particularly carbamazepine and phenytoin, increased the risk of thromboembolic events.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 중첩 환자-대조 연구(n = 2)와 코호트 연구(n = 9)에서는 DOAC와 CYP3A4/P-gp 유도제, 특히 카르바마제핀 및 페니토인을 병용하면 혈전색전증 사건 위험이 증가하는 것으로 나타났다.
all_evidence.population: Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) are frequently used for the treatment and prevention of ischaemic stroke in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

all_evidence.title: The utility of coagulation factor testing in non-anticoagulated elderly patients presenting with low-risk mechanical falls in the emergency department.
all_evidence.authors: Michaelides C; Raio C; Bulba N; Shah R; Fasanya C; Petrou S; Klein L
all_evidence.venue: The American journal of emergency medicine
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_3: METHODS: This was a multi-center retrospective observational study evaluating patients aged 65 years and older with low-risk mechanical falls not on chronic oral anticoagulation.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications.
all_evidence.outcome: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications. | This systematic review aimed to assess patient satisfaction with anticoagulation therapy for VTE and to highlight potential differences according to the type of anticoagulant. | The review focused on factors influencing the patient experience, such as perceived efficacy, ease of use, adverse effects, and health-related quality of life.

evidence.title: Prevention of nNon-Vitamin K Oral Anticoagulants-Related Gastrointestinal Bleeding With Acid Suppressants: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
evidence.authors: Dong Y; He S; Li X; Zhou Z
evidence.venue: Clinical and applied thrombosis/hemostasis : official journal of the International Academy of Clinical and Applied Thrombosis/Hemostasis
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: Whether the use of acid suppressants can reduce non-vitamin K oral anticoagulants (NOACs)-related gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB) remains unclear.
evidence.outcome: Whether the use of acid suppressants can reduce non-vitamin K oral anticoagulants (NOACs)-related gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB) remains unclear.
evidence.key_finding: Whether the use of acid suppressants can reduce non-vitamin K oral anticoagulants (NOACs)-related gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB) remains unclear.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 위산 억제제 사용이 비타민 K 비의존성 경구 항응고제(NOAC) 관련 위장관 출혈(GIB)을 줄일 수 있는지는 여전히 불분명하다.
evidence.population: Whether the use of acid suppressants can reduce non-vitamin K oral anticoagulants (NOACs)-related gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB) remains unclear. | The reduction was stronger for dabigatran than for rivaroxaban and apixaban. | The least reduction in the risk of GIB with acid suppressant co-therapy was rivaroxaban (dabigatran: RR: 0.53; 95% CI: 0.45-0.62; P = <0.001; I2 = 39.8%; apixaban: RR: 0.67; 95% CI: 0.54-0.84; P = <0.001; I2 = 0; rivaroxaban: RR: 0.73; 95% CI: 0.66-0.81; P = <0.001; I2 = 37.6%).

evidence.title: Use of tramadol and the risk of bleeding complications in patients on oral anticoagulants: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lévy C; Gosselin L; Vilcu AM; Steichen O
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Risk of bias was assessed using an adaptation of the Drug Interaction Probability Scale for case reports and case series and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for comparative studies.
evidence.key_finding: The 4 comparative studies reported an increased bleeding risk during tramadol and vitamin K antagonist intake which was statistically significant in one study; the pooled risk ratio of serious bleeding was 2.68 [95% CI: 1.45 to 4.96; p < 0.001].
evidence.key_finding_ko: 4건의 비교 연구에서는 트라마돌과 비타민 K 길항제를 함께 복용할 때 출혈 위험이 증가했다고 보고했으며, 이 결과는 1건의 연구에서 통계적으로 유의했다. 중증 출혈의 통합 위험비는 2.68[95% CI: 1.45~4.96; p < 0.001]이었다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether tramadol intake increases the risk of bleeding in patients receiving oral anticoagulants. | Comparative and non-comparative studies exploring bleeding complications among adult patients on oral anticoagulants and tramadol were included. | Most of the studies described tramadol-vitamin K antagonists' concomitant use; one case-control study also assessed dabigatran and rivaroxaban; one case report involved dabigatran.

evidence.title: Rate of abnormal uterine bleeding in women on anticoagulation for venous thromboembolism: systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Taree NA; Lee A; Sivak A; Rich R; Zhu N; Wei Linda Sun H; Wu C
evidence.venue: Journal of thrombosis and haemostasis : JTH
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.outcome: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | Primary outcomes were major bleeding (MB), clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding (CRNMB) from uterine sites, and unspecified AUB; secondary outcomes were iron deficiency anemia and recurrent VTE. | AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.key_finding: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 비정상 자궁 출혈(AUB)의 정의는 다양했다: 주요 출혈(MB)(n = 12), 임상적으로 관련 있는 비주요 자궁 출혈(CRNMB)(n = 10), 그림형 출혈 평가표(n = 2), 정의되지 않은 AUB(n = 7).
evidence.population: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | We aimed to compare the incidence and risk of AUB in women receiving DOACs vs low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH)/vitamin K antagonists (VKAs) for VTE and quantify anemia and iron deficiency risks. | Rivaroxaban showed a 2.7-fold higher AUB risk than LMWH/VKA (P < .01).

all_evidence.title: Advances and Challenges in the Application of Novel Oral Anticoagulants for Venous Thromboembolism Prevention Following Colorectal Cancer Surgery.
all_evidence.authors: Kun Y; Song Z
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a common but severe complication following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. | Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis.
all_evidence.key_finding: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 향후 연구에서는 LMWH-NOAC 순차 요법을 검증하고, 위험도 층화 프로토콜을 최적화하며, 회복 향상 경로 내 상호작용 문제를 다루기 위해 대규모 무작위 대조시험(RCT)을 우선해야 한다.
all_evidence.population: Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis. | The PROLAPS II trial demonstrated rivaroxaban's efficacy in reducing VTE after laparoscopic CRC surgery, with comparable major bleeding rates to placebo.

all_evidence.venue: Journal of thrombosis and haemostasis : JTH
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
all_evidence.outcome: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | Primary outcomes were major bleeding (MB), clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding (CRNMB) from uterine sites, and unspecified AUB; secondary outcomes were iron deficiency anemia and recurrent VTE. | AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
all_evidence.key_finding: AUB definitions varied: MB (n = 12), CRNMB uterine bleeding (n = 10), pictorial bleeding assessment chart (n = 2), and unspecified AUB (n = 7).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 비정상 자궁 출혈(AUB)의 정의는 다양했다: 주요 출혈(MB)(n = 12), 임상적으로 관련 있는 비주요 자궁 출혈(CRNMB)(n = 10), 그림형 출혈 평가표(n = 2), 정의되지 않은 AUB(n = 7).
all_evidence.population: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) disproportionately affects women of reproductive age, and abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) associated with anticoagulation, particularly direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), remains underreported. | We aimed to compare the incidence and risk of AUB in women receiving DOACs vs low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH)/vitamin K antagonists (VKAs) for VTE and quantify anemia and iron deficiency risks. | Rivaroxaban showed a 2.7-fold higher AUB risk than LMWH/VKA (P < .01).

all_evidence.title: Patient Satisfaction with Anticoagulation for Venous Thromboembolic Disease: A Systematic Review of Oral and Parenteral Regiments.
all_evidence.authors: Lefkou EE; Fragkaki A; Miliori MM; Latsou D; Panagiotopoulou K; Kotsi P; Gerotziafas G; Geitona M
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications.
all_evidence.outcome: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications. | This systematic review aimed to assess patient satisfaction with anticoagulation therapy for VTE and to highlight potential differences according to the type of anticoagulant. | The review focused on factors influencing the patient experience, such as perceived efficacy, ease of use, adverse effects, and health-related quality of life.
all_evidence.key_finding: Background and Objectives: Venous thromboembolic disease (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and imposes a substantial financial burden on health systems due to both the direct and indirect costs of acute management and long-term complications.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 배경 및 목적: 심부정맥혈전증(DVT)과 폐색전증(PE)을 포함하는 정맥혈전색전증(VTE)은 전 세계적으로 이환과 사망의 주요 원인이며, 급성기 관리와 장기 합병증에 드는 직접비와 간접비라는 두 종류의 비용 때문에 보건의료체계에 상당한 재정 부담을 준다.
all_evidence.population: This systematic review aimed to assess patient satisfaction with anticoagulation therapy for VTE and to highlight potential differences according to the type of anticoagulant. | Articles were identified through searches in major databases (PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library and others) using keywords including "patient satisfaction", "anticoagulation", "venous thromboembolic disease", and "quality of life". | The studies assessed patient satisfaction with different types of anticoagulation, including vitamin K antagonists (VKAs), direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), and low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) injections.

evidence.title: Advances and Challenges in the Application of Novel Oral Anticoagulants for Venous Thromboembolism Prevention Following Colorectal Cancer Surgery.
evidence.authors: Kun Y; Song Z
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a common but severe complication following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. | Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis.
evidence.key_finding: Future research must prioritize large-scale RCTs to validate LMWH-NOAC sequential regimens, optimize risk-stratified protocols, and address interactions within enhanced recovery pathways.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 향후 연구에서는 LMWH-NOAC 순차 요법을 검증하고, 위험도 층화 프로토콜을 최적화하며, 회복 향상 경로 내 상호작용 문제를 다루기 위해 대규모 무작위 대조시험(RCT)을 우선해야 한다.
evidence.population: Traditional anticoagulants such as low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists face limitations in clinical due to requirements for frequent monitoring, subcutaneous administration, and poor patient adherence. | Novel Oral Anticoagulants (NOACs), with advantages including oral administration, stable pharmacokinetics, and no requirement for routine monitoring, have emerged as potential alternatives for postoperative VTE prophylaxis. | The PROLAPS II trial demonstrated rivaroxaban's efficacy in reducing VTE after laparoscopic CRC surgery, with comparable major bleeding rates to placebo.

evidence.title: Triggers for identifying anticoagulation-associated adverse drug events in hospitalized patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: Other triggers exhibited lower pooled PPVs than elevated INR, including vitamin K administration (15 studies, PPV 0.222, 95% CI 0.153-0.290), abrupt medication cessation (14 studies, PPV 0.418, 95% CI 0.169-0.667), and activated partial thromboplastin time > 100 s (11 studies, PPV 0.336, 95% CI 0.173-0.498).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Anticoagulation therapy presents a high risk of adverse drug events (ADEs) in hospitalized patients, highlighting the need for effective detection strategies in clinical practice. | AIM: The review aimed to identify triggers for detecting anticoagulation-associated ADEs in hospitalized patients and describe the performance of these triggers. | We included studies on trigger tools for detecting anticoagulation-related ADEs in hospitalized patients.
evidence.key_finding: Other triggers exhibited lower pooled PPVs than elevated INR, including vitamin K administration (15 studies, PPV 0.222, 95% CI 0.153-0.290), abrupt medication cessation (14 studies, PPV 0.418, 95% CI 0.169-0.667), and activated partial thromboplastin time > 100 s (11 studies, PPV 0.336, 95% CI 0.173-0.498).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 다른 유발 요인의 통합 PPV는 상승한 INR보다 낮았으며, 여기에는 비타민 K 투여(15개 연구, PPV 0.222, 95% CI 0.153~0.290), 갑작스러운 약물 중단(14개 연구, PPV 0.418, 95% CI 0.169~0.667), 활성화 부분 트롬보플라스틴 시간 > 100초(11개 연구, PPV 0.336, 95% CI 0.173~0.498)가 포함되었다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Anticoagulation therapy presents a high risk of adverse drug events (ADEs) in hospitalized patients, highlighting the need for effective detection strategies in clinical practice. | AIM: The review aimed to identify triggers for detecting anticoagulation-associated ADEs in hospitalized patients and describe the performance of these triggers. | We included studies on trigger tools for detecting anticoagulation-related ADEs in hospitalized patients.

all_evidence.title: Clinical, economic, and humanistic impact of a multidisciplinary medication review with follow-up for anticoagulated patients treated with vitamin K antagonists in primary care: A cluster randomised controlled trial.

all_evidence.venue: Research in social & administrative pharmacy : RSAP
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: CONCLUSIONS: Community pharmacist medication review, in collaboration with general practitioners improve knowledge and adherence of patients treated with oral anti-vitamin K agents and enhances the achievement of their therapeutic INR ranges.
all_evidence.outcome: The outcome variables were INR stability, pharmacological adherence, vitamin K intake, knowledge about the use of acenocoumarol, quality of life, satisfaction with treatment, associated costs and avoided costs. | CONCLUSIONS: Community pharmacist medication review, in collaboration with general practitioners improve knowledge and adherence of patients treated with oral anti-vitamin K agents and enhances the achievement of their therapeutic INR ranges.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in patients with hyperkalemia and stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease: a single-center randomized controlled trial.
evidence.authors: Wang X; Chen D; Song X; Wang J; Zhang H
evidence.venue: The Journal of international medical research
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: To observe the clinical efficacy and safety of the short-term administration of different doses of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in the treatment of hyperkalemia in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease. | Constipation was the most common adverse drug reaction, and no treatment-related serious adverse events were observed. | CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 폴리스티렌설폰산칼슘을 15 또는 30 g/day 용량으로 투여하면 3-5기 비투석 만성 신장 질환 환자에서 나트륨, 인 또는 칼슘 수치에 대한 이상 영향 없이 칼륨 수치를 빠르게 낮출 수 있다.
evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: To observe the clinical efficacy and safety of the short-term administration of different doses of calcium polystyrene sulfonate in the treatment of hyperkalemia in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease. | CONCLUSION: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate administered at a dose of 15 or 30 g/day can rapidly reduce potassium levels in patients with stage 3-5 non-dialysis chronic kidney disease without adverse effects on sodium, phosphorus, or calcium levels.

evidence.title: Randomized trial of two maintenance doses of vitamin D in children with chronic kidney disease.
evidence.authors: Nadeem S; Tangpricha V; Ziegler TR; Rhodes JE; Leong T; Xiang Y; Greenbaum LA
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.outcome: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.key_finding: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 환자 중 누구에게도 비타민 D 독성이나 고칼슘혈증이 발생하지 않았다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Correction of nutritional vitamin deficiency is recommended in children with chronic kidney disease (CKD). | METHODS: We conducted a phase III, double-blind, randomized trial of two doses of vitamin D3 in children ≥ 9 years of age with CKD stages 3-5 or kidney transplant recipients. | CONCLUSIONS: In children with CKD, 1000 IU of daily vitamin D3 is unlikely to achieve or maintain a plasma 25(OH)D ≥ 30 ng/mL.

evidence.title: Effect of active vitamin D supplementation on muscle mass and function in peritoneal dialysis patients with sarcopenia: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence.authors: Wang L; Zhu B; Xue C; Zhou F; Luo Q
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_18: The incidence of adverse events did not differ between the two groups, and the daily administration of 0.5 µg of alfacalcidol was well-tolerated.
evidence.outcome: This single-center, randomized, open-label, parallel-controlled clinical trial was conducted at the Ningbo No.2 Hospital, which serves as a tertiary care center in the Ningbo region of Zhejiang Province, China. | The incidence of adverse events did not differ between the two groups, and the daily administration of 0.5 µg of alfacalcidol was well-tolerated.
evidence.key_finding: The incidence of adverse events did not differ between the two groups, and the daily administration of 0.5 µg of alfacalcidol was well-tolerated.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 두 군 간 이상반응 발생률에는 차이가 없었으며, 알파칼시돌 0.5 µg을 매일 투여하는 것은 내약성이 양호했다.
evidence.population: The data regarding the influence of active vitamin D supplementation on muscle mass and function in end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients have been inconclusive. | Our study aimed to determine the effectiveness of vitamin D supplementation on the alterations in muscle mass and function in peritoneal dialysis (PD) patients with sarcopenia. | ESRD patients with sarcopenia and vitamin D insufficiency or deficiency (serum 25(OH)D levels < 30 ng/mL) who were undergoing PD were recruited for the study.

all_evidence.title: Effects of sodium bicarbonate, cholecalciferol, and protein supplementation interventions on muscle mass and metabolic disturbances in patients with chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Leng S; Wu M; Yao J; Jiang X
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%).
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience a decline in muscle mass and metabolic disturbances, which may increase the risk of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. | NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%). | While protein supplementation may offer some value in reducing serum phosphorus and the incidence of adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: NMA results showed that cholecalciferol was advantageous in increasing muscle mass (SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), sodium bicarbonate performed better in improving serum albumin (SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), and protein supplementation ranked highest for reducing serum phosphorus (SUCRA = 64.9%) and the incidence of adverse events (SUCRA = 71.9%).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 네트워크 메타분석(NMA) 결과, 콜레칼시페롤은 근육량 증가에 유리했고(SMD = 0.68, 95% CI = 0.09 to 1.27), 중탄산나트륨은 혈청 알부민 개선에서 더 우수했으며(SMD = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.01 to 0.99), 단백질 보충은 혈청 인 감소(SUCRA = 64.9%)와 이상반응 발생률 감소(SUCRA = 71.9%)에서 가장 높은 순위를 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience a decline in muscle mass and metabolic disturbances, which may increase the risk of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. | Sodium bicarbonate, cholecalciferol, and protein supplementation are commonly used pharmacological and nutritional interventions; however, systematic evidence comparing their effects on muscle mass, metabolic status, and related outcomes in CKD patients remains lacking.
